messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Acme Corp (acct: ACME-219) opened a dispute. Mid-cycle downgrade happened and their March invoice shows the full charge, not a prorated credit. PO required (PO-7789) attached by the customer. Also initial card charge failed then retried; tax lines look duplicated (VAT applied twice). Need steps to issue a customer-facing credit note and update ledger so they can push corrected docs to AP. Invoice: INV-2026-045. cc @Marco
Marco: Can you paste the invoice lines and the exact downgrade timestamp? I can check the proration calc. Also: were they on committed seats or metered usage?
Priya: Downgrade ts: 2026-03-02T14:12:08Z. Committed seats: 50 -> 30 (reserved capacity plan). Billing period: monthly starting 2026-03-01. Invoice lines:
```
Line 1: Plan charge, qty 50, unit $10, period 2026-03-01->2026-03-31
Line 2: VAT 20% EU
Payment attempts: 2026-03-01 card_declined
2026-03-03 card_success
```
Customer says we should have charged qty 30 for remainder of month and credited 20 seats prorated.
Liam (billing-bot): Payment events from webhook: `payment_intent failed: card_declined` (2026-03-01T10:05Z), `payment_intent succeeded` (2026-03-03T12:10Z). No auto-credit on downgrade. Tax service shows VAT applied twice due to duplicate tax_id on customer record (tax_id: EU-VAT-123) from legacy import.
Marco: :thinking_face: Looks like two separate bugs — (1) proration wasn't applied on the downgrade event because the `apply_proration` flag was false on the downgrade API call, (2) duplicate tax_id caused VAT to be calculated twice.
Priya: The customer needs a credit note (they prefer a credit applied to next invoice, not a refund) and an updated invoice PDF for PO-7789 so AP can close. How do we: (a) create a credit note + ledger entries for mid-cycle downgrade when original payment succeeded after retry, and (b) ensure the revised invoice shows the PO line?
Marco: Procedure I recommend:
- Create credit note tied to INV-2026-045 for prorated amount of 20 seats (proration = remaining days / days in billing period). Mark reason `mid-cycle downgrade` and include PO-7789 on the PDF.
- Since original payment succeeded on 2026-03-03, apply the credit as balance credit (customer requested credit vs refund).
- Fix tax issue by removing duplicate tax_id on the customer and regenerating tax lines on the invoice + credit.
I'll compute exact amounts if you confirm days remaining.
Sara (acct-mgmt): Customer confirmed they want a credit note to apply to next invoice and need a revised invoice/credit bundle for PO upload. They also want a short explanation email they can forward to AP.
Priya: Per our proration policy: downgrade at 2026-03-02T14:12 UTC -> remaining full days = 29 out of 31 (policy uses remaining full days). Prorate factor = 29/31.
Marco: Quick calc (draft): unit $10 * 20 seats * 29/31 = $187.10 net. VAT 20% = $37.42. Total credit ≈ $224.52 (we'll round per finance rounding rules). I'll create a draft CN and attach.
FinanceOps-bot: Draft credit note CN-2026-117 created in staging (do not send). To publish run: `/finance publish-credit CN-2026-117 --env prod --note "mid-cycle downgrade credit"`
Priya: Two follow-ups: (1) Can eng-runtime triage why `apply_proration` defaulted to false on the downgrade API path? This is causing production inconsistencies between UI downgrades and API-driven changes. (2) Support needs a one-paragraph template explaining the corrected invoice + credit note for the customer (PO line required).
Marco: Agreed. @eng-runtime please take the downgrade handler; @Liam will handle tax_id cleanup and ledger reconciliation. I'll attach the draft CN in 15m.
Liam: I'll remove the duplicate tax_id and re-run tax calc for INV-2026-045 and CN-2026-117. Ledger reversal entry REV-9001 created to track the proration adjustment; will document mapping in accounting ticket ACC-3821.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll confirm with the customer once Marco attaches the PDF. ETA: publish EOD today.
